# Shady Grove Learning Center

> 3-Star Texas Rising Star day care and child care center in Irving, Texas 75060. Programs for infants (6 weeks) through after-school children (age 12). Breakfast, lunch and snacks included. Open Monday-Friday, 6:00 AM-6:30 PM.

## Key facts
- Business type: Child care center / day care / preschool / after-school program
- Address: 3200 W Shady Grove Rd, Irving, TX 75060 (South Irving)
- Phone: (972) 986-9351
- Email: shadygrovelearn@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday-Friday, 6:00 AM-6:30 PM
- Quality rating: 3-Star Texas Rising Star (Texas Workforce Commission quality rating system)
- Meals: breakfast, warm lunch and snacks included
- Subsidized child care: accepted (Texas Workforce Commission / Child Care Services)
- Enrollment: schedule a tour, complete enrollment packet (Texas health forms and immunization records), start. Full-time and part-time options.

## Programs
- Infants: 6 weeks to 12 months. Individualized feeding/sleep routines, tummy time, safe-sleep cribs, daily parent updates.
- Toddlers: 12 to 24 months. Language, sensory and fine motor play, songs, storytime, outdoor play.
- 2-Year-Olds: 24 to 36 months. Potty training support, social skills, colors, shapes, counting.
- 3-Year-Olds / Preschool: phonics, early writing, math and logic, STEM, kindergarten readiness.
- After-School & Summer Camp: ages 5 to 12. Homework help, sports, snack, care until 6:30 PM, holiday and summer full-day care.
